content:
Aisha Nguyen: Heads up — CatalystHealth usage down ~45% MoM across embeddings + gen routes. Champion (CTO) left last week, procurement pinged last Tuesday. Saw a competitor (BlueForge) invited for pilot demo. :exclamation:
Tom Le: Yikes. Any drop by product?
Aisha Nguyen: Mostly notes ingestion and rerank jobs. Top routes: /v1/embed, /v1/generate. Sample query infra ran for token counts:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) FROM prod_usage WHERE customer='catalyst' AND month='2026-02' GROUP BY 1;
```
Connor Miles: Can we get a fresh adoption dashboard + seat heatmap? I'll pull in usage and top user list.
Priya Rao: I'll reach out to the exec sponsor (Maria) — want to confirm if procurement is evaluating pricing or security. Also can offer a 1-hr enablement + cost optimization review.
Tom Le: Sounds good. Recommend a short commercial + enablement package: 3-week dedicated support window + 10% discount for commit. PMs ok with that?
Aisha Nguyen: PM said okay to offer the enablement session and explore discount if we can lock renewal by end of quarter. Also ask SEs to record a short 'how to' for rerank tuning.
Connor Miles: I'll schedule a 30m sync with their ops lead. Proposed times: Tue 11am or Wed 3pm PT. @Priya Rao can you confirm? :calendar:
Priya Rao: Tue 11am PT works for Maria. I'll send calendar and include SE + AM. Also attaching playbook: https://redwood.company/playbooks/renewal-quiet-account (internal).
OpsBot: Reminder created — follow-up task assigned to Aisha Nguyen due 2026-03-10.
Tom Le: Action items: 1) Connor — usage heatmap + top users (due 48h), 2) Aisha — draft email to Maria & Procurement (today), 3) Priya — calendar + exec outreach (today). :thumbsup:
Aisha Nguyen: Draft sent, CC'ing Tom. Will post thread summary after sync.
